feed.head: Good morning, Pirate Bay! Barnaby the parrot is awake and complaining.
Cressida Vane has awarded four stars to a mango and left a note.
Nigel would like it known that he is simply a man named Nigel.
Lost property: one violin, one enormous hat and one flip-flop.
Lounger nine has been booked by the same guest for eleven years.
Room service delivered nine hundred ice creams before breakfast.
The water slide queue is the second-longest thing on the island.
Today at Dance Cove: sun, snacks, a shanty and one MUNCHKIN.
Cressida Vane has reviewed a mango and given it six stars.
Staff say arrr at breakfast, at lunch and at the fire drill.
Correction: the beach ball cannon fires at eleven, not at ten.
Barnaby was on the decks for ten seconds and is banned for life.
The monkeys have packed small suitcases and are queuing for a boat.
Capt. Roger is smiling so hard that his hat has come loose.
Capt. Roger is still conga-ing, alone, magnificently.
Cressida Vane, final review of Dance Cove: eaten, four stars.
Mrs Fenwick-Hyde says this is now a three star holiday.
Barnaby has been saying void since breakfast. Barnaby is unbearable.
Maisie is doing the Wobble and it copies every move.
DJ Coconut played one final song and then bowed.
